title: Orbit and Signal Again
author: Ines Underhill
blurb: Marguerite Hartwell, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
